caveat: panel sensitivity; estimated incomplete-year H30 lacks natural-gap truth and hot-year calibration may fail; no confirmed new physical trend
period: each station's first through last complete year, identically for both policies
rankings: method-eligible year sets and common eligible years reported separately
regional_annual_mean: equal-station anomaly relative to that station's complete-year mean; require >=80% fixed-roster support
roster: >=15 complete observed years in 1981-2025; identical stations under both policies
uncertainty: connected-group bootstrap, independently selecting one of 20 stored imputations per station-year; no imputation before complete-year edges; does not model cross-station missing-error dependence or all estimator-training variation
